definitions.explanation: A person who writes novels or fiction as a profession or creative pursuit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧は⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{小説家|しょうせつか}だ。
{小説家|しょうせつか}になるのが⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧です。
examples.english: My dream is to become a novelist.

examples.japanese: この{小説家|しょうせつか}の⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧は⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I've read all the works of this novelist.

notes:
{小説家|しょうせつか} combines ⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧ (novel) + {家|か} (professional suffix).

RELATED ～{家|か} PROFESSIONS:
- ⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧ (writer, author)
- ⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧ (painter)
- ⟦{音楽家|おんがくか}→音楽家：27511_ongakuka⟧ (musician)
- ⟦{漫画家|まんがか}→漫画家：08643_mangaka⟧ (manga artist)
- ⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧ (specialist, expert)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {小説家|しょうせつか}: novelist (writes novels specifically)
- ⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧: writer, author (broader term)
- ⟦{著者|ちょしゃ}→著者：03501_chosha⟧: author (of a specific work)

USAGE NOTES:
- The ～{家|か} suffix indicates someone who specializes in or practices something professionally
